question: Where do I check whether the Stellar network, its validators, or SDF's hosted services such as Horizon are having problems right now?

golden.answer: Use status.stellar.org for current incidents and scheduled maintenance on Mainnet, Testnet, and SDF-run services such as Horizon and Friendbot; it offers update subscriptions. dashboard.stellar.org shows live ledger closes, protocol version, and fees. Obsrvr Radar (radar.withobsrvr.com) shows validators, organizations, and quorum health. Report any current state with the time you checked.
keyFacts: status.stellar.org reports current incidents and scheduled maintenance.
status.stellar.org covers SDF-run services such as Horizon and Friendbot.
dashboard.stellar.org shows live ledger and network activity.
Obsrvr Radar shows validator nodes and quorum health.
avoid: Do NOT assert from memory that the network is up or down right now.
golden.notes: Grade the places to check, not a status reading. A block explorer alone does not answer this.

activation.author: gap lanes gap-1, gap-2, gap-3 (Claude Fable 5.2)

corroboration.claim: status.stellar.org tracks incidents and scheduled maintenance for Mainnet, Testnet and SDF-run services.

evidence.note: Status Page entry: tracks network incidents and scheduled maintenance; subscribe to updates.
Components list includes the public and test networks, SDF validators, SDF Horizon, Friendbot, Dashboard and the APT repository.

corroboration.claim: dashboard.stellar.org shows live Mainnet and Testnet state: last ledger, close time, protocol version, fee stats.

evidence.note: Dashboard entry: 'Displays the current status of the Testnet and Mainnet. Monitor fee stats, recent operations, lumen supply'.
Page showed protocol version, last ledger and average close time over 200 ledgers.

corroboration.claim: Obsrvr Radar lists Stellar nodes, validators and organizations and reports quorum intersection.

evidence.note: Obsrvr Radar entry: 'View Stellar network nodes and visualize consensus.'
Network explorer showed node, validator and organization counts and quorum intersection.
